steps.code:
# Fetch all note contents and parse them
parsed_notes = []
for note in all_notes:
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=login_result['access_token'], note_id=note['note_id'])
    # Parse date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = detail['title'].replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '')
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in detail['content'].split('\n'):
        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[key.strip()] = val.strip()
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits, 'note_id': note['note_id']})

# Check first and last
print(parsed_notes[0])
print(parsed_notes[-1])
